high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "marketing.stories." The post features a historical advertisement for Gillette safety razors. The top part of the image shows a black-and-white illustration of five soldiers wearing military uniforms and hats, each holding a Gillette safety razor across their shoulders. Below the illustration, there is text that reads: "The Armies of the World Use the Gillette Safety Razor." The main body of the post provides information about the company's financial situation and its success during World War I.
